text.en:
26th. MAY, 1984 No. S 15-THE EMERGENCY (EXTRADITION (MALAYSIA AND SINGAPORE}! ORDER, 1984 Notification under Section 1(2) In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 1 (2) of the Emergency (Extradition (Malaysia and SingaporelJ Order, 1984, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan has been pleased to appoint 19th. May, 1984 as the date on which the said Order shall come into force in relation to the extradition of fugitive criminals to and from the Republic of Singapore. Dated this 19th. day of May, 1984.

BY COMMAND,

PENGIRAN BAHRIN (Pengiran Laila Kanun Di-Raja), Minister of Law cum Minister of Communications.
